messages:
Elaine CS: Noticing our renewal-risk table is noisy for the May trial cohort. Exported a sample and ~35% look like account variants (email+alias, SSO mismatch). File: exports/may_trial_samples.csv
Tom Onboarding: That explains the false positives — healthscore jumps to 'active' on signup even if it's a duplicate. We end up pinging the same org multiple times.
Jamie Data: Quick analysis shows many rows have null sso_id or mixed-case emails. My adhoc SQL to cluster:
```sql
with c as (
  select lower(coalesce(sso_id, regexp_replace(email, '\\+.*', ''))) as canonical_id,
         min(created_at) as first_seen,
         array_agg(id) as ids
  from accounts
  where created_at between '2025-05-01' and '2025-05-31'
  group by 1
)
select canonical_id, first_seen, cardinality(ids) as count from c order by count desc limit 100;
```
Jamie Data: Suggestion: add computed column `trial_family_hash` = md5(canonical_id) and compute distinct families when scoring. Also mark sibling rows with `duplicate_of=canonical_id` and `duplicate_flag=true` for ops to review.
Ravi Ops: Operational plan: nightly dedupe job will populate those columns and write to a staging table. Extra accounts get excluded from playbooks and renewal-risk calculations. We can expose a small review UI for CS to confirm duplicates.
Elaine CS: Playbook change request: replace trigger `trial_count_org > 1` with `distinct_trial_families > 1` and add a short cooldown so we don't re-fire after a dedupe tag.
Tom Onboarding: I'll create CST ticket and a PR. Plan: PR by EOD tomorrow, QA in staging, deploy feature-flagged next week. Assigning to @Jamie Data and @Ravi Ops for the backend + ops job.
Jamie Data: I'll also build a Grafana panel `metric:dup_trial_family_ratio` with a warning alert at 0.04 and critical at 0.1. Backfill job will run for historical cohorts and tag past accounts.
Elaine CS: UX ask: small one-click post-signup question for suspected duplicates: "Is this account already represented by a teammate?" with options: yes/no. If yes, capture teammate email. Helps root cause (SSO vs personal alias).
Ravi Ops: We'll pipe the micro-survey into the dedupe pipeline so CS tickets include the user's response. Also will add a line to the onboarding README explaining duplicate flags.
DedupBot: scheduled nightly_dedupe_job on 2025-07-23T03:00:00Z (job_id: ndj-20250723-02) :white_check_mark:
GrafanaBot: Created alert `dup_trial_family_ratio > 0.04` on dashboard `cs/healthscore` (panel id: 42).
Tom Onboarding: CST-409 created: "trial-family dedupe + healthscore update" assigned to Tom, Jamie, Ravi. I'll post PR link when ready. Thanks everyone :tada:
Elaine CS: Great — hoping this cleans the renewal signal before next forecast review. If the backfill changes renewal-risk by >5% we'll pause and re-evaluate the heuristics.
